title: The Illusion of Specialization: Unveiling the Domain-Invariant "Standing Committee" in Mixture-of-Experts Models
reasoning: The paper uses the MMLU dataset, which includes subjects like 'philosophy, ethics, religion' as part of its 'Humanities' domain. However, the paper's focus is on analyzing the internal routing mechanics of Mixture-of-Experts models (i.e., which experts get activated for which tasks) rather than evaluating the model's performance, correctness, or stance on ethical or religious topics. Therefore, it is not a paper about evaluating faith or ethics.
